articles.title: GHSA: HtmlSanitizer: CSS Removal DoS
articles.summary:
### Impact

An unauthenticated request can occupy one synchronous application worker for seconds. Concurrent requests add CPU cost and can keep all workers busy, sustaining denial of service without user interaction.

### Patches

The issue has been patched in versions  9.0.967 and 9.1.968-beta.

### Workarounds

Disallow the style attribute.
